capabilities: Generate unique IDs in seven formats
Insert IDs at the cursor or copy them to the clipboard
Set a default format with a comparison guide
Expose per-format API functions for Templater and scripts
Decode creation time from time-based IDs
extras: Makes no network requests and never reads the clipboard; requires Obsidian 1.13.1+; no hotkeys assigned by default; same-second counter is per device, so multi-device setups need collision-resistant formats.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mint unique identifiers, and the available ID formats differ in length, ordering and collision safety.

relations.evidence: Call any format from Templater or your own scripts, with its own options.

summary: Command-and-API plugin that generates unique IDs in base36, Sqids, NanoID, UUID, ULID and TypeID formats for insertion or clipboard copy.
